title: OpenGL Sandbox
description: C++ mass/wave simulation on a 500×500 toroidal grid — mass radiates a diffusing field, and cells follow its gradient but repel on contact and trade momentum when they collide. WASD propels you by injecting a dipole into the field rather than moving you directly. Built from scratch pre-AI in raw OpenGL 3.3 + GLFW + GLEW + ImGui. Companion GPU compute experiments — Conway's Game of Life, directional gravity, heat diffusion — live on separate branches. Web port via Claude in progress; Windows, macOS and Linux downloads below.

title: mutual™
description: Camera hardware that cryptographically signs video at the moment of capture — before any software can touch it. If a single frame is altered, the signature breaks. Proof of authenticity for forensics, insurance, and legal evidence.

title: artefact(s): LeNet-1
description: Physical installation translating LeNet-1 — the first convolutional neural network (Bell Labs, 1989) — from matrices to copper and from scalar activations to brightness. 1.63m frame of transparent flex PCBs, WS2812B LEDs, low-iron glass, Raspberry Pi 4. A handwritten digit is fed in every 10 seconds and propagated layer by layer through the physical network. Co-built with Nick Oh as socius labs.

title: Oikolex
description: Flutter mobile app for tenant reviews of rental properties — map-based exploration with markers and heatmap, review submission, admin feedback panel. Firebase backend (auth, realtime DB, cloud functions).
